name: Calculate a unit rate
short_description: Calculate one amount per unit from two provided quantities and check the units.
self_assessment: I can calculate one unit rate from two quantities without help.
description: Calculate one amount per unit from two provided quantities and check the units. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Calculate cost per item using abstract tokens

builds_on.note: Reading supports extracting quantities from word problems.
